neighbours.label: adversative 'but' / 'But' / 'pero' turning a concession ('is great, but it is not …')
fire: Saving money is great, but it is not the only goal.
This plan sounds wonderfully easy. But it depends on perfect weather.
The soup may not look nice, but it does taste good.
Son medidas muy populares, pero poco útiles.
Reading is good for you, but it won't fix your eyes.
That sounds impressively fast. But the test used a small file.
The hotel may not be new, but it does have a pool.
Es un coche barato, pero poco seguro.
quiet: Saving money is great, and it is a sensible goal.
This plan sounds wonderfully easy. It depends on good weather.
The soup looks nice, and it does taste good.
Son medidas muy populares y muy útiles.
Reading is good for you, and it will calm your mind.
That sounds impressively fast. The test used a large file.
The hotel is new, and it does have a pool.
Es un coche barato y muy seguro.

predictions: 5/8 fire; the same clauses joined with 'and' stay quiet
notes: Card: ' but' x12, ' But' x6, ' However' x2, ' pero', ' Mais'. Probe: ' pero' 0.38, ' But' 0.35, ' but' 0.18-0.27; 'and it is good' 0.03. Medians may sit near the line.
